comparisons.business_owns: Commercial question, customer/value decision, experiment and economic consequence.
comparisons.other_owns: Question-driven source acquisition, provenance, contradiction analysis, synthesis and claim audit.
comparisons.handoff: Decision/use, population, claim, required freshness, known facts and unknowns, source restrictions, effort ceiling and requested evidence.
comparisons.return: Attributable source/evidence/claim links, underlying-source independence, contrary evidence, dates and uncertainty; not invented local customers.
comparisons.limit: Default main contains only three bootstrap files. Compare declared architecture; do not claim installed capability.
comparisons.decision: Compose through a bounded research brief and evidence return; keep the business decision with Business Building.

comparisons.business_owns: Commercial intention, actual terms/behaviour, economics, customer obligations and authorised business response.
comparisons.other_owns: Legal scoping, authoritative research, applicability, legal drafting/review and professional escalation.
comparisons.handoff: HF01–HF07 issue packet: exact versions, actors, jurisdictions, dates, conduct, data-use limits, contradictions and precise legal question.
comparisons.return: Author/remit, reviewed facts, authority/status, jurisdiction, effective/valid-as-of dates, conditions, required/prohibited acts and re-review trigger.
comparisons.limit: Default main contains only bootstrap intent. This review makes no current substantive-law finding or professional clearance.
comparisons.decision: Consume attributed, applicable constraints; unresolved jurisdiction/authority blocks the affected commitment, not honest draft work.

comparisons.business_owns: Customer/value hypothesis, offer and terms, commercial experiment, money/capacity constraints and scale decision.
comparisons.other_owns: Interaction requirements, hypotheses, lowest useful fidelity, accessibility, states, UX validation and engineering handoff.
comparisons.handoff: Accepted offer/price/rights, target task, evidence and unknowns, experiment question, no-change constraints and any applicable legal finding.
comparisons.return: Interaction contract, states/recovery/accessibility, measured task outcomes and limits, hypothesis state, accepted design version and unresolved implementation risk.
comparisons.limit: Actual SKILL.md and command references exist; README says semantic benchmark and clean installation remain gates. No installation was performed here.
comparisons.decision: Use UX to resolve interaction uncertainty; retain its confidence vocabulary without upgrading it to paid demand, retention or commercial approval.

comparisons.business_owns: Business outcome in scope, accepted commercial facts/obligations, decision rule and permitted commitment.
comparisons.other_owns: Repository inspection, affected technical contracts, code change, appropriate verification, failure diagnosis and implementation repair.
comparisons.handoff: Bounded behaviour, exact inputs/outputs, invariants, privacy/rights/quality constraints, acceptance examples and change authority; UX contract if relevant.
comparisons.return: Actual revision/diff, tests and results, remaining limitations, operational assumptions and any business-relevant behaviour change.
comparisons.limit: Default main has three bootstrap files. Engineering intent is not an implemented/validated skill product.
comparisons.decision: Keep architecture and tools in engineering; a passing test proves only tested behaviour, not demand, delivered customer value or permission to deploy.

comparisons.business_owns: Reusable business semantics, skills/packs/cases/benchmarks and domain evidence. Consuming business owns its actual records and choices.
comparisons.other_owns: Family principles, packaging/evaluation/composition contracts, registry/maturity and evidence-qualified shared abstractions.
comparisons.handoff: Stable project identity, revision, scoped capabilities, actual gate evidence and optional compatibility status; no customer state or private project knowledge.
comparisons.return: Structural conformance and registry metadata; no central commercial-quality score.
comparisons.limit: Observed registry status remains proposed, Pactwright planned; no registry mutation or maturity promotion in Stage 20.
comparisons.decision: Preserve independent distribution and domain-owned evaluation. New bootstrap recipes do not retroactively reopen accepted Stages 1–15.

comparisons.business_owns: Business meaning, assumptions, evidence interpretation, commercial constraints and smallest-change proposal.
comparisons.other_owns: Delivery lifecycle authority, typed canonical nodes, authorised decisions/contracts/briefs and delivery Evidence; optional extensions own their additional state.
comparisons.handoff: A proposed bounded deliverable and acceptance conditions with preserved versions, scope/non-scope, limits and actual owner authority; through the consuming project’s configured agent pack.
comparisons.return: Delivered outputs, verification/results, deviations and residual risks tied to actual revision; post-delivery observations separate.
comparisons.limit: Inspected runtime uses `pack.yml` and `skills/<name>.md`; no inference that `PACK.md` or `integrations/pactwright.yml` is automatically loaded. No integration executed.
comparisons.decision: Keep optional explicit binding and existing lifecycle. Business review cannot directly create/mutate graph nodes or turn delivery Evidence into commercial validation.

abstraction_candidates.name: Assumption / evidence / decision handoff
abstraction_candidates.common_need: Preserve the meaning, provenance, uncertainty and authority of information at an ownership transition.
abstraction_candidates.variations: Research source/claim distinctions; legal authority/applicability; UX mechanism/hypothesis; business observation/interpretation/commitment; Pactwright canonical delivery records.
abstraction_candidates.decision: Use existing documented handoffs. Candidate only; no common database, schema migration or runtime.
abstraction_candidates.production_evidence: Architecture and source-contract recurrence observed; no independent implemented Business Building handoff run yet.

abstraction_candidates.name: Experiment contract
abstraction_candidates.common_need: Choose a bounded question, adequate method, comparison and predeclared decision-changing evidence.
abstraction_candidates.variations: Research may resolve uncertainty without intervention; UX tests an interaction/human outcome; software verifies behaviour; business needs actual customer/economic evidence. Pactwright Contract records agreed delivery, not experimental validity.
abstraction_candidates.decision: Retain domain records and terminology. Link dependent tests; do not create one experiment platform or treat every test pass as market validation.
abstraction_candidates.production_evidence: Repeated design needs, including existing UX/source contracts; no measured cross-domain equivalence established.

abstraction_candidates.name: Constraint diagnosis and smallest sufficient correction
abstraction_candidates.common_need: Locate the owning failure layer, preserve sound work and review only true dependencies.
abstraction_candidates.variations: Research claim/source; legal fact/authority/clause; UX requirement/flow/state; engineering requirement/interface/code/test; business channel/price/delivery/cash. Pactwright scope changes return through its lifecycle.
abstraction_candidates.decision: Share the already accepted principle; retain domain repair units and authority. No central diagnosis engine or cross-project automatic rewrite.
abstraction_candidates.production_evidence: Strong architectural recurrence; owning-domain runtime/business repair evidence still needed for new shared implementation.

abstraction_candidates.name: Validity / confidence metadata
abstraction_candidates.common_need: Prevent evidence from becoming stronger, more current or more broadly applicable during translation.
abstraction_candidates.variations: Event/publication/retrieval dates; legal commencement and valid-as-of; UX VALIDATED_IN_CONTEXT; business cohort/window/cost basis; graph byte revision and delivery completion. None is a universal confidence number.
abstraction_candidates.decision: Preserve original field meanings and add explicit context in the receiving record. No scalar score or enum conversion that invents confidence.
abstraction_candidates.production_evidence: Source-level semantic differences observed; insufficient evidence for a universal validity engine.

handoff_reviews.kind: Authored synthetic handoff review, not a research run
handoff_reviews.input: A research report attributes the same acquisition-cost claim to three articles that repeat one underlying source. Local paid-customer data is absent.
handoff_reviews.adequate_return: Retain all locators but identify one underlying evidence source; preserve claim scope/dates and missing local cohort data. Business Building can propose a test, not report verified local CAC.
handoff_reviews.reject: Count three independent validations or import the advertised number as the business’s observed CAC.
handoff_reviews.preserved: Accepted customer/offer and actual evidence states.

handoff_reviews.kind: Authored synthetic handoff review, not legal research or advice
handoff_reviews.input: A cancellation proposal has exact current terms and observed UI behaviour, but applicable jurisdiction and reviewer finding are unknown.
handoff_reviews.adequate_return: Prepare the bounded issue packet, preserve rights and facts, request applicability/conditions through an authorised reviewer. Keep the dependent legal commitment unresolved.
handoff_reviews.reject: Infer the jurisdiction from the business-model pack or call the proposal legally approved because copy is clear.
handoff_reviews.preserved: Existing refund/cancellation obligations; no message sent or terms changed.

handoff_reviews.kind: Authored synthetic vocabulary/ownership review, not a UX trial
handoff_reviews.input: UX marks a cancellation interaction VALIDATED_IN_CONTEXT for observed task completion in a stated small study. The business has no subsequent paid-renewal evidence.
handoff_reviews.adequate_return: Retain the scoped task observation and confidence label, study limits and accepted terms. Paid renewal and satisfaction remain separate unresolved claims.
handoff_reviews.reject: Map the UX label to business PASS for retention or permission to scale paid acquisition.
handoff_reviews.preserved: Price, renewal/refund terms, audience and accepted interaction scope.

handoff_reviews.kind: Authored synthetic delivery review, not a software execution
handoff_reviews.input: Engineering reports a tested calculation fix at a named revision; unit tests pass on synthetic input. The customer experiment has not run.
handoff_reviews.adequate_return: Record the implementation and exact tested numerical behaviour. Recalculate affected business scenarios with actual inputs when available; keep demand and experiment outcome unknown.
handoff_reviews.reject: Treat the synthetic test pass as observed demand, new revenue or authorisation to deploy/charge.
handoff_reviews.preserved: Metric definitions, input evidence states, unrelated code and commercial decisions.

handoff_reviews.kind: Actual registry/source inspection with an authored adverse interpretation
handoff_reviews.input: The pinned family registry records business-building-skills as proposed with Pactwright planned; local documents and design checks exist.
handoff_reviews.adequate_return: Retain the actual registered status and separate current design evidence. Later promotion requires its own gates and authority.
handoff_reviews.reject: Overwrite the registry to mature because the structural files and links pass.
handoff_reviews.preserved: Family registry and all other repositories remain unchanged.

handoff_reviews.kind: Authored synthetic semantic/format review, not Pactwright execution
handoff_reviews.input: A Pactwright Evidence record says a prototype was delivered and verified. A Business Extension Pack has PACK.md; the inspected agent-pack parser requires pack.yml and flat skill resources.
handoff_reviews.adequate_return: Keep prototype delivery distinct from exposure/customer outcome; keep the business pack outside the agent-pack loader. An optional binding must be explicitly implemented and tested at compatible versions.
handoff_reviews.reject: Mark the business experiment successful from delivery Evidence or claim that copying PACK.md installs a Pactwright agent pack.
handoff_reviews.preserved: Core node/lifecycle semantics, original business evidence and standalone skill distribution.

claim_scope: Actual repository/source comparison and authored bounded handoff reviews. No installed cross-project execution, commercial observation, professional legal conclusion or maturity promotion.
